title: The Rock
tagline: Break into Alcatraz. Break out the snacks.
about: An FBI chemist and a former SAS man break into Alcatraz to stop a rogue general.
cue: Serve the snacks when Mason gets his haircut at the hotel.

    StartersSan Francisco sourdoughWarm sourdough with salted butter and oil with dukkahHow to make it1 sourdough loaf125g soft salted butter100ml extra virgin olive oil3 tbsp dukkahWarm the loaf at 200°C.Tear into chunks.Serve with butter and a shallow dish of olive oil with dukkah scattered on top for dipping.Fisherman's Wharf prawnsGarlic chilli prawns in butter and white wine, with breadHow to make it3 tbsp olive oil5 garlic cloves1 chilli600g green prawns, peeled60g butter60ml white wine1 small bunch parsley1 baguetteSlice the garlic and chilli.Heat the oil and fry the garlic and chilli briefly.Toss the prawns over high heat.Add the butter, wine and parsley. Serve with the baguette for the juices.MainsMason's hotel room serviceButter-basted rib eye with béarnaise and fritesHow to make it60ml white wine vinegar2 sprigs of tarragon3 egg yolks200g clarified butter, warm1kg potatoes1.5 L vegetable oil, for frying4 rib eye steaks40g butter4 sprigs of thyme2 garlic clovesCut the potatoes into chips.Fry the chips once in the vegetable oil at a lower heat and drain.Reduce the vinegar with the tarragon until a couple of tablespoons remain.Whisk the reduction with the yolks over low heat and drizzle in the warm clarified butter.Sear the rib eyes, then baste with butter, thyme and garlic.Rest the steaks and fry the chips again until crisp.Serve the steaks with the sauce and chips.San Francisco cioppino and garlic toastThe city's own seafood stew, across the bay from the RockHow to make itAs written, serves 4Fennel, garlic and chilli simmered in tomato and white wine with prawns, mussels, clams and snapper, served with charred garlic sourdough.Soften 1 sliced fennel bulb, 1 onion and 4 garlic cloves in olive oil with a pinch of chilli flakes.Add 250ml white wine, 400g crushed tomatoes and 500ml fish stock and simmer 20 minutes.Add 500g clams and 500g mussels, cover 3 minutes, then 400g snapper chunks and 12 green prawns for 4 minutes more until everything is cooked.Finish with parsley.Grill thick sourdough slices rubbed with garlic and olive oil.SweetsSan Francisco chocolate squaresFudgy walnut chocolate squares with flaky saltHow to make it200g dark chocolate150g butter250g caster sugar3 eggs100g plain flour100g walnuts1 tsp flaky saltHeat the oven to 175°C and line a tin. Melt the chocolate with the butter.Whisk in the sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour.Toast the walnuts and fold them in.Pour into the tin and bake.Sprinkle with flaky salt and cool.Cut into squares.DrinksMason's single malt Rob RoySingle malt Scotch stirred with sweet vermouth and bitters over ice, strained into chilled coupes with a cherry and a twist of orange.How to make it4 coupe glasses200ml single malt Scotch80ml sweet vermouth8 dashes of aromatic bitters1 tray ice4 cocktail cherries1 orangeChill the coupes.Stir the Scotch, vermouth and bitters over ice until icy.Strain into the coupes, drop in a cherry and twist orange peel over each.
